info.title: XEDO integration contracts
info.description: Existing route inventory plus typed deployment-preview/GEE probe contracts and partial planning-trial envelopes. This is not a complete typed specification for every legacy route or every nested calculator value. Separate JSON Schemas describe field shapes; runtime also validates entity references, modes, units, geometry, revisions and source-specific conditions. Sites enforces the configured audience/access boundary before the Worker. Browser users use the platform session; programmatic callers can use the platform OAI-Sites-Authorization: Bearer <service token> header. The Worker does not implement standalone user authentication. X-XEDO-Device-Token is an additional credential only on the documented Pi receive branches and auth check. No aircraft/dispenser command API or AI inference endpoint exists.

post.summary: Find actual Sentinel-2 acquisitions covering an inspection polygon
post.description: Fixed GEE Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized metadata search. Dates span up to 90 days, cloud cover is scene-wide, and AOI dimensions are bounded to 100 km. Returns at most 12 fully covering acquisitions. No arbitrary GEE expression, external URL, database write or oil inference.

geometry.description: WGS84 single-ring Polygon, no holes, at most 120 vertices.

200.description: GEE scene list with exact acquisition time, footprint, native resolution and scene cloud cover; an empty list is a valid no-match result.

422.description: Invalid boundary, date range or cloud cover.

503.description: Missing GEE configuration or unavailable upstream.

post.summary: Create a bounded RGB image session for one verified GEE acquisition
post.description: Revalidates the canonical fixed-dataset source and full polygon coverage. Returns a 30-minute encrypted stateless session, validated geometry and scene, expiry and same-origin tile URL. Uses computePixels rendering with the existing computation permission when maps.create is unavailable. Google tokens and keys are never returned.

sceneId.description: Canonical gee:COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/... scene returned by search.

geometry.description: The exact selected WGS84 inspection Polygon.

200.description: Verified image-session manifest.

422.description: Invalid scene or insufficient image coverage.

get.summary: Render a verified Sentinel-2 RGB PNG tile
get.description: Server-side authenticated GEE imagery. Accepts only an unexpired, untampered session issued by map; clips imagery to the approved AOI bounding box. Tiles outside the AOI are transparent PNGs. No raw raster download, Google credentials, aircraft action or database access.

200.description: RGB or transparent PNG, 256 by 256 pixels.

410.description: Session expired; renew the selected image.

post.description: Receive telemetry only. Envelope accepts source_mode live or replay and 1–100 events with matching device_id/source_mode. Live requires X-XEDO-Device-Token for the configured live device; replay relies on workspace access and cannot update live state. Simulated events come from the simulator rather than this ingestion endpoint. mission_id references a persisted MissionPlan, not a deployment preview or survey ID. Sending status never commands a flight or dispenser.

200.description: Success; creation may instead return 201, and accepted asynchronous work may return 202.

202.description: Telemetry batch accepted with accepted/duplicates counts.

parameters.name: X-XEDO-Device-Token
parameters.description: Additional configured Pi receive-channel secret. Required only for live telemetry, captured_live uploads, and results belonging to captured_live captures. Not a user login token or a drone command.

post.description: Receive an original image and JSON metadata as multipart/form-data. source_mode is live or simulated. captured_live requires a configured live device token and live source mode; imported uploads rely on workspace access and do not prove an attached camera. Missing dimensions remain unknown. File validation and incident/mission/device linkage are enforced at runtime.

200.description: Success; creation may instead return 201, and accepted asynchronous work may return 202.

parameters.name: X-XEDO-Device-Token
parameters.description: Additional configured Pi receive-channel secret. Required only for live telemetry, captured_live uploads, and results belonging to captured_live captures. Not a user login token or a drone command.

file.description: Valid JPEG/PNG/WebP original image, 1 byte to 8 MiB.

post.description: Receive output from an external processor; this endpoint does not run an AI model. Results attached to a captured_live image require that capture device token; imported-image results rely on workspace access. Completed results require an algorithm version, pixel coordinate space, duration 0–86400000 ms, known original image dimensions and up to 100 ordered bounding boxes inside those dimensions. Pixel boxes are not converted to geographic oil boundaries.

200.description: Success; creation may instead return 201, and accepted asynchronous work may return 202.

post.description: Reads the original immutable Quick mission survey snapshot. Accepts no replacement geometry or GEE expression. Returns the same estimated route for both views, with optional bounded historical GEE samples. No records, flights, dispensing settings or commands are created. A blocked plan or unavailable GEE account is represented inside an HTTP 200 response. This response is not MissionPlan 1.0 and is not accepted by mission-plans/import. Workspace access is enforced by the hosting platform; no Pi device token belongs on this endpoint.

200.description: Preview result, including generated/blocked plan and connected/not_configured/disabled/error GEE context.

Cache-Control.description: Responses are not cacheable by the browser or CDN.

404.description: Saved survey or linked incident not found.

405.description: Only POST is supported; response has no JSON body.

422.description: Invalid fields, units, geometry or original Quick mission snapshot.

503.description: Unexpected server/storage failure; inspect the error and retryable flag.

get.description: Read-only metadata request using server-side service-account credentials. HTTP 200 includes state not_configured or error when GEE cannot be read. This does not measure imagery/tile load time, perform image analysis or prove computation permissions. No Pi token or GEE key is supplied by the browser.

get.description: Read-only source lookup under the Site access boundary. Returns the immutable original Quick mission boundary with available incident/scene/time linkage; does not use the edited current observation. No Pi token or external service call.

422.description: Missing/invalid survey ID or unsupported/missing original boundary.

post.description: Combines supplied drift, camera/flight, export-review and oil assumptions. No database mutations, live weather/official-airspace lookup, GEE call, AI inference or hardware action. HTTP 200 may contain incomplete/blocked component states; missing values remain null. Uses a saved frozen survey source or a separate trial polygon. Detailed nested fields are partial contracts documented in /docs/planning-trial.md.

200.description: Calculated envelope with independent component states, including incomplete/blocked results.

Cache-Control.description: Responses are not cacheable by the browser or CDN.

422.description: Invalid input, source snapshot, units, geometry, timing or unavailable export checks.

post.summary: Recalculate and download one QGC trial file
post.description: Recalculates from submitted inputs and checks again before returning a JSON envelope containing one QGC 5.1.x .plan text. sortieIndex is zero based. Requires complete camera/wind/battery estimates and manual source/home/reference/constraint/time checks. No aircraft transfer, arm/start, camera trigger or release command; no DJI KMZ export. Native import and SITL remain untested.

200.description: One local file artifact and manual check report.

Cache-Control.description: Responses are not cacheable by the browser or CDN.

SitesServiceAuthorization.name: OAI-Sites-Authorization
SitesServiceAuthorization.description: Optional programmatic access to the configured Sites platform boundary, value Bearer <service token>. Browser sessions use platform-managed access instead; the Worker does not validate this header itself.

PiDeviceToken.name: X-XEDO-Device-Token
PiDeviceToken.description: Additional receive-channel credential for the configured live Pi. Required for auth-check, live telemetry, captured_live images and processing results belonging to captured_live captures; never a flight/release command.
